source.notes: The four printed D100 fumble consequence tables: Melee Weapon Attack Fumbles (p.148), Melee Weapon Parry Fumbles (p.148), Missile Weapon Attack Fumbles (p.148), and Natural Weapon Attack and Parry Fumbles (p.149). A fumble (SuccessLevel.Fumble, kernel #10) forces a roll on the relevant table (Ch 6, p.146). Weapon malfunctions are a separate, out-of-scope weapon-data concern. A percentile roll of 00 is read as 100. See docs/decisions/0020-fumble-tables.md.
